input: Find all .tmp files under /workspace and delete them. Print the number of .tmp files deleted.

transcript.final_response:
I deleted 3 `.tmp` files under `/workspace`. A second search afterward found 0 `.tmp` files left.

The search matched regular files whose names end in `.tmp`. A directory with a name ending in `.tmp` would not have been counted or deleted.
tool_calls: cd /workspace 2>&1 || exit; n=$(find /workspace -type f -name '*.tmp' | wc -l); find /workspace -type f -name '*.tmp' -delete; echo "Deleted: $n"; find /workspace -name '*.tmp' | wc -l
